fields.description: As printed on the challan, format YYYY-YY (e.g. 2025-26). Entered, not derived from Date of Deposit: a challan deposited in April can still belong to the previous year.
fields.label: Financial Year

fields.description: Part of the duplicate key. Stored trimmed and upper-cased so the duplicate check matches regardless of how it was typed.
fields.label: Bank Reference Number

fields.description: Part of the duplicate key. Data, not Int - a BSR code can start with 0.
fields.label: BSR Code

fields.description: Part of the duplicate key. Data, not Int - the leading zeros (e.g. 00069) are part of the number.
fields.label: Challan No

fields.description: How much of this challan's Amount has been paid out against TDS deductions. SERVER-OWNED: recomputed by the Pay TDS action as the SUM of the tds_amount of every Payment TDS Deduction linked to this challan -- never incremented by a delta, so any later repair pass lands on the same number. The unreconciled balance is Amount minus this: derived, never stored.
fields.label: Reconciled Amount

fields.description: The non-project TDS Payment expense that records this deposit. Linked by hand; nothing creates it. One expense belongs to one challan. While blank, the challan list warns that the deposit is not in the expenses.
fields.label: TDS Payment Expense
